description: This file defines the PlatformFontResolver class in the PdfSharp.Fonts namespace, providing platform-specific logic for resolving fonts. It includes methods for resolving typefaces in different environments (GDI, WPF, CORE), creating font sources, and handling font style simulations. It also contains platform-specific code blocks to handle font creation and resolution on Windows, Linux, and other systems.

classes.name: PlatformFontResolver
classes.description: Provides platform-specific methods to resolve and create font sources for different environments (CORE, GDI, WPF, WUI) within PDFsharp.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves a typeface given font family name and style options, returning font resolver information, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: TryWindowsPlatformFontResolver
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a font typeface on Windows platform, returning font resolver info if successful.

methods.name: CreateFontSource
methods.description: Creates font source data from system font information, platform-specific (GDI, WPF).
